verdict.rationale: Brex documents an official, first-party hosted MCP server at https://api.brex.com/mcp. It lets AI assistants manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions and track bills. The docs give a concrete connection command (`claude mcp add --transport http brex https://api.brex.com/mcp`), and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described, and documented detail on MCP-specific authentication and the full tool list.
